parameters.name: settingID
parameters.description: Id of the setting row, for example default-site

value.name: Default Site
value.description: What to show when Nginx is hit with an unknown Host

description:
Returns one stored setting row. The answer is 404 for an unknown id and for the rows served elsewhere (CrowdSec, landing pages and the runtime sections). OIDC and GeoIP come without their secrets.
Needs: an administrator (a token needs its Administrator switch)
